# writing-skills

> 14 writing-style skills for AI agents: 7 measurable frameworks and 7 character
> voices, as plain SKILL.md files.

## Installation
- Skills CLI: `npx skills add writing-skills`
- npm: `npm install writing-skills`
- Python: `uv add writing-skills`
- Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add surendranb/writing-skills`

## Skills
- Frameworks: plain-language, business-writing, corporate-communication,
  gov-uk-style, asd-ste100, google-dev-docs, journalism-ap
- Voices: ted-lasso, jack-sparrow, shrek, yoda, winnie-the-pooh, paddington,
  bob-ross
